item.title: Rider men’s basketball scorched by red-hot Marist
item.description: POUGHKEEPSIE, N.Y. — Rhyjon Blackwell scored 21 of his game-high 23 points in the first half and a scorching-hot Marist thrashed Rider, 81-52, on Thursday night at McCann Arena. The Red Foxes (16-7, 10-4) have dominated both meetings this season against the Broncs (3-19, 2-11) with an average margin of victory at 25.5 points.
